anchors.description: White-painted vertical door leaf/jamb edge of the interior doorway at the right of the scene, spanning from the floor threshold up to the door head.
anchors.visible_evidence: Continuous white-painted door edge is visible from the light threshold at the floor (about y=300) up to the white door head (about y=65); both chosen points lie on that white surface a few pixels inside its ends. Its projected height and depth-consistent scale match a standard 80-inch interior door.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: The white vertical band may be the open door leaf or the door jamb/casing; both belong to the same 6-ft-8-in doorway, so the height prior holds within a few cm. Older NYC openings can be 78 in (1.98 m) and head casing can add ~2-4 cm. Pixel placement uncertainty ~3-4 cm.
